drawing_summary.title: Circular Flange with Bolt Hole Pattern
drawing_summary.description: Stepped cylindrical flange with central bore, 12 equally spaced M6 threaded holes on bolt circle, and internal stepped profile with fillet transition
assumptions: Drawing is to scale with dimensions in millimeters
M6 holes are through or tapped holes based on 12XM6 callout
Surface finish callouts Ra1.6 and Ra6.3 indicate machined surfaces
Datum A is the bottom face as indicated by datum triangle position
R2.00 callout indicates fillet radius at internal step transition

notes: Section A-A cuts horizontally through center showing stepped internal bore profile
Hatched regions on left and right sides represent solid flange material
Central unhatched region is through bore void with stepped diameters
Three distinct axial layers visible: lower flange (9mm), middle body (11mm), upper rim (8mm), total 28mm
Internal bore steps from ø99.00 at bottom through ø105.00 to ø115.00 at top opening
Outer diameter is ø139.00 at lower flange
Upper section shows reduced outer diameter at approximately ø129.00
R2.00 fillet shown at internal step transition on right side of section
Bolt holes on ø115.00 PCD not directly intersected by section cutting plane
Bottom face serves as datum A for flatness and perpendicularity controls

views.name: top_view
views.summary: Circular flange with 12 equally spaced M6 threaded holes on a bolt circle, and a large central bore opening. The outer silhouette is the flange OD, with bolt holes visible on the top face annular rim, and a central through-bore.

contour_stack.evidence: Outermost circle corresponds to ø139.00 dimension in section view, representing the flange outer diameter
Dimension 129.00 shown in section as upper portion diameter, visible as step edge on top face
ø115.00 from section view corresponds to bolt circle diameter for 12xM6 holes; holes shown on top annular face
ø105.00 dimension in section shows inner bore opening at top face level
ø99.00 shown in section as narrower bore diameter below upper opening, visible through ø105 opening

entities.evidence: 12xM6 callout in top view, holes shown equally spaced on bolt circle, located on solid annular region of top face
Central opening visible in top view, section confirms stepped bore from ø105 to ø99
ø105.00 is the top-level bore opening diameter per section view

notes: Bolt holes are M6 threaded, 12 equally spaced at 30° intervals on PCD ø115
Central bore is stepped: ø105 upper opening transitions to ø99 lower bore
Section shows R2.00 fillet at inner bore transition but this does not create additional top-view contour
Bolt hole depth not dimensioned in top view; requires section view confirmation
The ø115 bolt circle lies within the ø129 body diameter and outside the ø105 bore opening, confirming holes are on the solid annular top face

views.name: section_A-A
views.summary: Stepped cylindrical flange with central bore, upper recess cavity, and outer flange. Three distinct axial regions: lower flange (9mm), middle body (11mm), upper rim (8mm). Central bore Ø99 through full height. Upper cavity opens to Ø105 from top, creating internal floor visible from above. Fillet R2.00 at upper internal corner.

axial_bands.evidence: Hatched region from Z=0 to Z=9. OD=139 (outer_diameter_flange), ID=99 (inner_diameter_bore). Solid flange base.
Hatched region from Z=9 to Z=20. OD steps in to 129, ID remains 99. Solid wall section.
Hatched outer ring from Z=20 to Z=28. OD=139 flange returns, ID=115 defines upper opening. Top face visible.
Unhatched region between Ø115 and Ø105 from Z=20 to Z=28. Open cavity, void space.
Hatched inner ring from Z=20 to Z=28. OD=105, ID=99 (central bore). Creates internal floor at Z=20 visible through upper opening.
Through hole Ø99 full height. Central void.

entities.evidence: Ø99.00 dimension shown, unhatched center region through full section height.
Unhatched annular void between Ø115 and Ø105, depth 8mm from top (28-20=8).
R2.00 callout at corner where internal floor meets Ø105 wall.
Annular floor at Z=20 created by upper cavity, bounded by Ø105 (outer) and Ø99 (central bore).

notes: Section cutting plane A-A does not intersect bolt hole axes; bolt holes not directly visible in section hatching.
Bolt hole PCD not dimensioned in section view; do not infer from profile diameters 129, 115, or 105.
Upper cavity creates annular void where bolt holes likely pass through, but start face requires top view correlation.

global_constraints.description: Part is axisymmetric about central vertical axis
Total height is 28.00 mm from bottom face (datum A) to top face
Central bore diameter is 99.00 mm, passes through entire part
12 holes M6 threaded, equally spaced on bolt circle
Bolt circle diameter is 129.00 mm (hole centers)
R2.00 fillet at upper-right internal corner transition in section view
Surface finish Ra1.6 on bottom face and internal bore (datum A faces)
Surface finish Ra6.3 on top flange face
Flatness 0.25 on top face relative to datum A

modeling_sequence.description: Create base solid cylinder at outer flange diameter
Remove central bore through entire height
Create upper stepped recess from top face down 11.00 mm at diameter 105.00
Create outer annular recess from top face at diameter 115.00 to 139.00, depth 9.00 mm
Apply R2.00 fillet at internal corner where bore steps from 99.00 to 105.00
Create 12x M6 threaded holes on PCD 129.00
modeling_sequence.note: Holes visible in top view through upper annular recess but start from recessed floor, not outer top rim

uncertainties.issue: M6 thread depth and whether holes are through or blind not explicitly dimensioned
Section silhouette suggests possible small chamfer or relief at bottom outer edge, but no dimension given
Section shows 11.00 and 9.00 vertical dimensions; exact interpretation of which applies to inner vs outer recess inferred from hatching pattern
R2.00 callout location inferred from section arrow position; exact adjoining diameters assumed 99.00 to 105.00 transition
